title: Best Drone Photographers (2026): Aerial Photos and Video
description: How to hire a drone photographer or videographer for real estate, events, construction or tourism: permits, safety, deliverables, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Drone photographers capture aerial photos and video for real estate listings, construction progress, events, tourism, farms and marketing. Aerial views show scale and context that ground shots cannot. Projects go wrong when the pilot is not licensed where required, airspace rules are ignored, weather plans are missing, or footage is unusable because of wind or poor light. This guide helps you hire a safe, legal and skilled drone pilot.

faq.q: Does the pilot need a license?
faq.a: In many countries commercial drone flights require a license or registration. Ask the pilot to confirm they meet local rules.
No. Airports, cities, crowds and protected areas often have restrictions. The pilot should check airspace and permissions.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Wind and rain can cancel flights. Agree on rescheduling rules.

faq.q: Do I get photos and video?
faq.a: Agree on deliverables: edited photos, raw video, edited clips or all.
Many professional pilots carry insurance. Ask, especially for flights near people or property.
